tool_input.summary: Researched sketchpad root route startup. Confirmed / is routed to Home and HomeDropZone contains the import input, but Playwright root loads never surface the Home DOM. Evidence points to startup stalling before AppRouter/Home commit, likely from the consolidated monolith eagerly loading heavy modules and docs content.
